learnings: API errors during file review should not cause the entire package to be marked inconclusive when other files are successfully reviewed and found safe
The audit tool should distinguish between 'file could not be reviewed due to tool error' and 'file reviewed and found suspicious'
When multiple models review the same package, infrastructure failures in one model should not override successful reviews from other models
Consider implementing retry logic or fallback models when API errors occur during file review
